configure_profiling: configure habitat_sim profiling to start capture at a specific step and capture a set number of steps
on_start_step: signal the start of a new step to the habitat_sim profiling system
range_push: push a named profiling range marker onto the NVTX stack for performance tracing
range_pop: pop the most recent profiling range marker off the NVTX stack
RangeContext: annotate a code block with a profiling range using a context manager or decorator
